row:
Massage with Mike is a professional massage therapy and manual therapy education channel by Michael Eric Everson, Manual Osteopath, Registered Massage Therapist (RMT), and educator with 15+ years of clinical experience.

Learn evidence-informed massage therapy techniques, manual osteopathy, and continuing education for massage therapists and bodyworkers worldwide.

Professional CE Courses
Michael is the founder of EversonCE, an accredited continuing education platform offering massage CE/CEU courses approved by organizations such as the NCBTMB, Florida Board of Massage, and MTANS. 

Whether you’re a massage therapist, RMT, LMT, or student, this channel helps you treat with confidence and think clinically.

Subscribe for weekly hands-on demos 
Contact: info@eversonce.com
